 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-54397  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Intergovernmental Affairs
  Committee meeting of Tuesday, January 23, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  24-54398  Recommendation to receive and file a staff presentation on Report on Proposed
  Legislation Related to Retail Theft, Drug Use, and “Smash and Grab” Crimes,
  gather input from the Intergovernmental Affairs Committee, and forward the
  Committee’s recommendations to City Council for approval.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  24-54399  Recommendation to receive and file a staff presentation on Proposition 4, “The
  Safe Drinking Water, Wildfire Prevention, Drought Preparedness, and Clean Air
  Bond Act of 2024”, gather input from the Intergovernmental Affairs Committee, and
  forward the Committee’s recommendations to City Council for approval.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 Opportunity to address the Intergovernmental Affairs Committee on non-agenda items. Each
 speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

  A motion was made by Member Kerr, seconded by Vice Chair Allen, to
